comment: The profile of the fixture brute (D-956). It weighs damage and kills above its own safety, and it never heals. PR-11 ships the weights alone (D-958), and PR-30 tunes them. The steal list holds a draught, some gold, and a hood, at the gear chance of D-1051 (D-383, D-949). The drop list holds a rare tonic (D-1042).
